scope: Primary-source news for a power-system engineering/operator tutorial. Six recommended developments; three named U.S. operational workflows lead. Company-reported results are not independent audits.

N01.title: Field Notes • HyperQ deployment in PJM’s Cycle 1
N01.locator: June 11 Executive summary; footnotes 1–3; Production execution metrics; April 29 deployment entry
N01.reading_focus: Separate site-control readiness from final compliance; computational latency excludes human validation. The ADK migration is future work.

N02.title: How agentic AI can help grid operators speed up interconnection
N02.date: 2025-12-08 (linked chronological entry in N01); live article reviewed 2026-10-17
N02.locator: Tapestry’s HyperQ; Under the hood; Figures A–D
N02.reading_focus: Gemini, narrow agent subtasks, orchestration, agreement clustering, RAG and page/bounding-box citations. It does not establish a current ADK deployment.

N03.title: Siemens’ Gridscale X redefines system operations and agentic transmission planning
N03.locator: Gridscale X PSS E section; separate preceding Alliander paragraph
N03.reading_focus: Do not attribute Alliander platform migration to the newly unveiled agentic PSS E capabilities; the up-to-50% response-time claim has no disclosed benchmark.

N04.title: National Grid Full Year Results 2025/26: Video Webcast Transcript
N04.locator: PDF page 10 (zero-index page 9), capital control tower paragraph; continuation on PDF page 11
N04.reading_focus: CEO describes agentic stage-gate project assurance in current use. SDK, exact geographic rollout and agent-specific savings are not disclosed. Subsequent AI outage-scheduling statements use future tense.

N05.title: Iberdrola accelerates the adoption of agentic AI to support the talent of its professionals
N05.locator: Body paragraphs beginning 'The company currently has nearly 500' and final human-control paragraph
N05.reading_focus: The nearly-500 total mixes deployed agents with agents in development. General AI network-restoration claims are not agent-specific outcomes.

N06.title: Successful Interconnection Reforms, Other PJM Initiatives Seek To Maximize Electricity Supplies
N06.reading_focus: Customer directly confirms HyperQ testing and ongoing validation in March. Use N01 for the supplier’s later April deployment and June metrics.

existing_sources_rechecked.locator: CAISO: multi-agent AI in production for outage management
Opening announcement and engineers / deterministic simulation paragraph

developments.status: Supplier-reported live deployment in PJM Cycle 1; April 29, 2026 entry. Customer had confirmed testing March 16.
developments.platform: HyperQ; Gemini multimodal agents with custom guided orchestration, RAG, document grouping and evidence citations. ADK migration is described as future work.
developments.task: Initial site-control application readiness, before downstream electrical studies and final compliance determination.
agent_actions: Produce cited readiness reports for engineers.
developments.human_role: PJM engineers make final compliance determinations.

quantitative_evidence.denominator_note: 9,312 = four criterion assessments for 2,328 agreement bundles; it is not 9,312 distinct generation applications.

caveats: No reported accuracy/confusion-matrix denominator in this article.
Historical manual-versus-compute speedup is not a matched comparison; omit the 20x+ headline.
Runtime is not the full interconnection timeline. Do not label site-control checking electrical power-flow validation.

proposed_slide.title: April–June 2026: PJM uses agents before the electrical study
proposed_slide.status_label: LIVE DEPLOYMENT • UNITED STATES • supplier report
points: HyperQ prepares cited site-control readiness reports; PJM engineers retain final determination.
811 applications; reported computational median 6m15s and p95 28min.
Agents extract and reconcile legal/parcel evidence; these timings exclude human review.
proposed_slide.teaching_transition: The first engineering bottleneck may be the evidence entering the study, before any solver runs.

developments.status: Customer’s July 28, 2025 account was a pilot; OATI’s 2026 IEEE PES field report states production daily use.
developments.platform: OATI AI Genie; shared orchestrator with Workflow, Advisor and Recon agents.
developments.task: Outage-review preparation and operator situational awareness.
agent_actions: Monitor critical outages and flag emerging concerns.

quantitative_evidence.metric_scope: Next-day request analysis before reviewers start their day; not a per-request latency percentile.

caveats: Exact production start date and benchmark sample count are not published.
The separate ~40 analyst-hours context is not a matched baseline for eight machine-minutes.
Not evidence of autonomous dispatch or switching.

proposed_slide.title: 2026 field report: CAISO’s outage agents reach daily operations
proposed_slide.status_label: PRODUCTION • UNITED STATES • supplier field report
points: Workflow, Advisor and Recon agents share outage context through an orchestrator.
The reported nightly batch exceeds 500 next-day requests and finishes in under eight minutes.
Operators receive flags, citations and situational views, and keep final authority.
proposed_slide.teaching_transition: An operational agent is defined by its workflow, evidence and authority boundary—not its chat interface.

developments.status: September 17, 2026 program announcement with Duke engineers already using the collaborating system; rollout scale unspecified.
developments.platform: Agentic Grid Planning on AWS; AWS-managed agents coordinate existing physics software, grid models, scripts and engineering standards. Specific SDK/model/runtime undisclosed.
agent_actions: Run and coordinate study workflows through existing engineering software.
developments.human_role: Engineers direct studies and make final engineering decisions; simulation software performs deterministic analysis.
caveats: Do not calculate an exact speedup from unspecified hours.
Program-wide up-to-4x/92% claims are not Duke-specific measured outcomes.
Do not infer Strands or AgentCore from the AWS brand.

proposed_slide.title: September 2026: Duke and AWS put agents around trusted studies
proposed_slide.status_label: NAMED ENGINEER USE • UNITED STATES • AWS announcement
points: Agents prepare and coordinate interconnection studies using existing physics tools.
Duke reports data preparation falling from two weeks of manual work to hours.
The engineer owns the study and final decision; the agent manages workflow.
proposed_slide.teaching_transition: Tool orchestration can change engineer effort while leaving numerical responsibility with the solver.

developments.country: Global product; separate Dutch platform customer
developments.status: May 5, 2026 unveiling of agentic Gridscale X PSS E capabilities; no named production user of those new capabilities established by this release.
developments.platform: Gridscale X PSS E: simulation, domain-specific AI automation and cloud-native planning workflows; over 2,000 open APIs reported.
developments.task: Transmission planning and large-load/data-center connection studies.
agent_actions: Automate planning-study workflows through the platform’s integration interfaces.
developments.human_role: Planners assess and respond to connection requests; release does not disclose a detailed agent-approval design.

quantitative_evidence.vendor_claim: Up to 50% shorter connection-study response time

caveats: Alliander’s 85 migrated applications and leaner IT landscape establish shared-platform adoption, not agentic PSS E adoption.
Avoid treating the up-to-50% product claim as a controlled utility result.
Do not connect Eigen industrial PLC metrics to PSS E.

proposed_slide.title: May 2026: agentic planning enters a major solver product
points: Gridscale X PSS E combines simulation with AI workflow automation and open APIs.
The announced target includes data-center and large-load connection studies.
A product capability and a named utility deployment require different evidence.
proposed_slide.teaching_transition: Next ask which case, model, input version and solver result the agent is allowed to change.

developments.country: UK/US group; exact agent rollout geography not specified
developments.status: May 14, 2026 CEO statement of a capital control tower already providing agentic project assurance.
developments.platform: Capital control tower; software vendor, model and agent framework undisclosed.
developments.task: Early capital-project optioneering and stage-gate documentation review.
agent_actions: Assess project options and documentation at stage gates.
Provide project managers timely feedback and lessons from prior projects.
developments.human_role: Project managers adjust plans; no autonomous construction or grid-control authority is claimed.
caveats: No agent-specific time, accuracy or savings result is supplied.
Later statements about thousands of delivery scenarios and access-outage optimization are future plans.
Do not attribute nearby FLISR outage-minute or gas-crew-travel metrics to these agents.

proposed_slide.title: May 2026: National Grid reports agentic project assurance
proposed_slide.status_label: CURRENT USE • GROUP DISCLOSURE • geography unspecified
points: A capital control tower checks options and documentation at project stage gates.
Project managers receive feedback early enough to revise plans.
The company identifies the workflow, but discloses neither framework nor measured agent-specific benefit.
proposed_slide.teaching_transition: A useful case can verify actual use without supporting a numeric performance claim.

developments.country: International group; do not label the count U.S.-only
developments.status: August 17, 2026 adoption announcement; nearly 500 agents deployed OR in development across the group.
developments.platform: Group agent portfolio; platform/framework not disclosed.
developments.task: Knowledge access and task assistance across electricity networks, generation, IT and corporate work; individual power-engineering agent deployments not enumerated.
agent_actions: Assist repetitive processes and technical-work coordination.
developments.human_role: Company explicitly retains human control and responsibility for decisions.

quantitative_evidence.denominator: Combined deployed agents and agents in development

caveats: Not 500 deployed agents; not 500 grid-control agents.
The release’s general AI restoration and network-incident statements are not specifically attributed to the agent portfolio.
No agent-specific operational result or stack is disclosed.

proposed_slide.title: August 2026: utility adoption grows—but count the right thing
points: Iberdrola reports nearly 500 agents deployed or being developed across its group.
Technical-knowledge support is relevant to network and generation teams.
The announcement preserves human decision responsibility and does not identify 500 deployed grid agents.
proposed_slide.teaching_transition: The tutorial will count complete engineering tasks, not marketing portfolios.

secondary_leads_not_upgraded_to_deployme.finding: Open-source reference application with Strands/Bedrock alternatives, weather/location/emergency agents and work-order input. Not evidence of a named utility deployment.

secondary_leads_not_upgraded_to_deployme.name: Hitachi HMAX Energy

secondary_leads_not_upgraded_to_deployme.finding: Vendor discusses operator-assistance potential and future load-shift agents. Existing Alabama Power GridOS outcomes remain evidence of automation foundations, not a verified LLM-agent deployment.

secondary_leads_not_upgraded_to_deployme.finding: Official industry catalogue labels the offering commercially deployed and describes multi-source risk workflows, but names no utility implementation or measured deployment result.

editorial_recommendation: Use the first five developments as the substantive opener; include Iberdrola only if a sixth news item helps explain adoption evidence. Keep CAISO, Duke and PJM as the three named U.S. operational case anchors. Drop pipeline-only, biomedical and generic platform score comparisons from this power-only route.
